key_insight: Task exchangeability lets researchers use synthetic data for valid inference by matching the current question to historical tasks with real data in a mathematically comparable way.
engineering_relevance: Provides a principled way to deploy synthetic data generators and LLM-based evaluators in research pipelines while preserving statistical validity.
method: Identify historical tasks with real observed data.
Check whether the current task is exchangeable with those tasks.
Apply inference procedures that remain valid under exchangeability, with extensions that retain guarantees beyond exact exchangeability.
evidence_signal: The framework is illustrated on public opinion surveys using silicon samples and on AI evaluation using autoraters.
watch_item: Validity depends on finding sufficiently comparable historical tasks, so poor task matching or distribution shift can weaken guarantees.
paper_title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
